notes.title: 🦜DevLog #10 - Demo Update!
notes.content:
A new demo update is here, introducing new species, visual enhancements, and a range of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and optimizations to make your pet shop even smoother to manage. 

  
[hr][/hr]
Changelog
Added:

3 Piranhas Fierce and fast. A dangerous but fascinating addition to any aquarium section.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/5a895c0365dbb3fc02e2bd58529053f011c8a714.png"] 

4 Goldfish: A colorful and relaxing classic. These peaceful fish are perfect for beginner pet shop owners.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/650f98b659bdfeacab76c9520597bcc4745d6e73.png"]

1 Hyacinth Macaw Bright blue and highly intelligent - this large parrot brings energy and personality to your bird enclosures.   


Changes:

The animal type is now displayed on the screen when using animal transport bags

Lamp lighting visuals have been improved - illuminated areas are now more clearly visible

NPC positions near habitats and shelves have been rebalanced for better spacing and realism

Aquarium fish capacity doubled – you can now house more fish in each tank

Terrarium stands now show the maximum number of animals instead of the minimum (note: large species will still limit how many can be added)

Character limit applied to the names of adopted animals

Windows and doors are now included in quick wall painting when using the Shift key

Product stands optimized for better performance and stability   


Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the delivery area could be positioned outside the map

Fixed a bug where a worker would still start mop-cleaning animations after the player finished the task 

Other:

 The character's jumping feature has been removed for improved gameplay consistency


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/b50de4bd30d07d80f3090f5a7e70d0beb57e281e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/abe3d8600239b08e16d07dabe5fc03f3eb2b2c62.png"][/carousel]

[hr][/hr]


Thanks for playing! 

More species, systems, and updates are in development - stay tuned. 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2824380/Exotica_Pet_Shop_Simulator_2"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Demo Update | 27-06-2025
notes.content:
Roof Placement is now easier!
The roof installation system has been changed to an easier system! It’s now much more intuitive - no more needing to paint the roof walls manually. You can see the difference in the below before-and-after comparison. 


[previewyoutube="MeUQ3x73agY;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]Changelog
 Added/New

A new shortcut has been added to the Tools Menu for easier access to "Q" feed slots. Swapping between feeds is now much smoother.

A character limit has been added to signs. (Max: 10 letters)

Changes

Roof placement method updated - It's now easier and doesn't require painting the roof walls.

Working agency renewal shortened - Now set to 7 days instead of 15.

Animal placement animation removed -Dropping animals into their habitats is now instant.

Bed and bowl split - Beds and food bowls for adopted animals are now separate objects, both found in construction mode.

Feed/accessory placement reworked - You no longer get locked in place while placing multiple items. Just hold LMB to place, or use "C" to collect back into the box fluidly.

Improved: Storekeeper behavior has been optimized.

Adjusted: Store leveling now requires less EXP - level up faster!

Fixes

Fixed: Workers no longer leave items floating mid-air when dismissed mid-task.

Fixed: You can’t place the computer desk outside anymore.

Fixed: Signs now correctly attach to the edges of new roofs.

Fixed: Construction mode now remembers the last object’s placement direction properly.

notes.title: Demo Update | 13-06-2025
notes.content:
Hello,

We released a small update with some QoL improvements and fixes. Thank you very much for the feedback!


Changelog
ADDITIONS

Added ability to open/close shop and send customers out of the store.

Added previously missing WASD and zoom key indicators in Build Mode.

Added a video tutorial to the tutorial screen displayed at game start. (Videos can be accessed later from the computer.)

Added functionality to move icons within the computer interface by holding and dragging, with support for single-key opening.

FIXES

Fixed an issue preventing doors from being placed on the map border.

Fixed roofs were incorrectly placed over the Delivery Area.

Fixed an issue where bank loans were incorrectly processed without requiring players to have twice the loan amount available. Now, players must have twice the loan amount in their account to take out a loan, and a warning message has been added to inform players of this requirement.

Fixed object selection not exiting properly when clicking on another object in Build Mode.

Fixed the issue where players could select equipment from the tools menu and use it simultaneously while placing furniture, animals, food, or accessories.

Fixed feeding animals across multiple living areas simultaneously.

Fixed furniture placement issue where players could throw furniture boxes upon opening, leaving them open and preventing proper placement or exit from placement mode.

notes.title: DevLog #8 – Employee Agencies & Storekeepers 🏪
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LkqjVLbpwbE;full][/previewyoutube]
Responsible for checking the boxes placed on the storage stand and transferring them to the sales shelf. This makes it much easier to monitor your sales and accessory shelves.

Employee Levels
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/50ae11e608aa24e366f8395526c55816829d82f9.png
The employee hire page lists employees under three main headings:
 ☆ 1-Star Employees: Very cheap, but can take a very long time to complete assigned tasks.
 ☆☆ 2-Star Employees: More reasonably priced; task speed varies from normal to slow.
 ☆☆☆ 3-Star Employees: Expensive, but work efficiently and quickly.
Depending on their star level, employees can help the player with animal care, shop cleaning, cashier duties, and warehouse work.

Employee Types
Each employee can be assigned up to three different tasks:
Cleaning and Care: Cleans the shop and animal habitats.
Cashier: Works at the cash register, prepares the customer’s requests, and delivers items to them (if the cashier feature is enabled for that employee).
Storekeeper: After checking stock levels for accessories and animal feed in the warehouse stand, automatically moves items to the sales shelves as needed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/e8f2b3631b96a954b0eb021110d1219df65e0996.png

Employee Statistics 
 Animal Phobia:Represents the employee’s phobia toward specific animals; they refuse to care for those animals.
 Feeding Percent: Feeds animals when their habitat’s hunger level drops below 65%.
 Feeding Speed: Time (in seconds) it takes to feed animals (e.g., 1.2 seconds). Higher numbers mean slower feeding.
 Water Spending: The amount of water used to clean habitats and the shop. Higher numbers mean more water consumption per object cleaned.
 Clean Speed: Time (in seconds) it takes to clean living areas (e.g., 1.4 seconds). Higher numbers mean slower cleaning.
 Stock Speed: How quickly the storekeeper restocks accessory and feed stands. Higher numbers mean slower restocking.
 Cashier Feature: Indicates whether the employee can perform cashier duties.

notes.title: DevLogs #7 - 🐍 Python Eggs 🥚
notes.content:
Welcome to our seventh monthly dev update for Exotica Pet Shop Simulator 2! We’re still hard at work fine - tuning everything for the big release, and we’re thrilled to share the latest features we’ve been crafting. From colorful stands to rare snake hatchlings, there’s a lot to look forward to - let’s dive into what’s new this month!

Python Egg Breeding – 🥚Hatch Something Special!
We’re making great progress on the snake breeding system, and it’s shaping up to be super exciting:

Hatch Your Own Snakes: Pair up compatible reptiles, wait for them to lay eggs, and watch the hatching process in real time. We’re still tweaking the timing to get it just right!
Rare Colors & Patterns: There’s a chance for unique color mutations to appear - they’re rare, but spotting one will feel so rewarding!
Gameplay Hint: Keep your snakes’ habitat comfy and their needs met to boost breeding success. We’re also experimenting with how care might influence rare hatchling odds - more on that soon!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/d04eced85fe271aca1eb61f9812dedacd9979a5a.gif
Customizable Stands – More Options to Play With!
Color & Wood Variations: You asked for more variety, and we’ve delivered! We’ve expanded the color palette and added new wooden finishes for a natural look.
On - the - Fly Adjustments: Already set up a stand? You can swap its design without messing up your shop layout - perfect for experimenting!
Dev Tip: Try using bright, bold colors to make your rarest animals stand out. It’s a great way to catch visitors’ eyes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/94f2a8f18cd537e376baad41138001dedbcb1e9b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/dc14a8edd9ee874e7ace9bc3d4261bfdf7977977.png
Patterned Pathways – Step Up Your Style!
New Sidewalk Types: We’ve added more patterns like classic tiles and decorative stonework to give your shop that extra flair.
Streamlined Construction: We’ve been optimizing the construction mode to make updating your walkways smoother and more intuitive. It’s feeling really good in testing!
Design Insight: Coordinating your pathway patterns with your stands can create a seamless, immersive vibe that visitors will love.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/f1d1ccf1e8ca096f282d633291d75b7fe11a8fe9.png
Six Custom Signboards – Add Some Personality!
Versatile Designs: Choose from six signboard styles - think rustic, modern, whimsical, and more. We’re still designing a few extra styles for later!
Personal Text: Add your shop’s name, advertise daily deals, or write a warm welcome message for your customers.
Pro Tip: Swap your signboard style for in - game events or promotions - it’s an easy way to keep your shop feeling fresh and festive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/a28273be74aa56783e8a441ac7b8872bdb862569.png

Demo Coming Soon – Get Ready to Play!
We know you’re eager to start running your own exotic pet shop, and we’re so excited to announce that a free playable demo is on the way! Here’s what you can expect:

Core Mechanics: Get a taste of the basics - breeding, feeding, and managing your shop.
Select Animals: You won’t see the full roster just yet, but you’ll get to care for a few fan - favorite critters.
Early Feedback: We’ll be looking for your thoughts to help us polish the game before the full release. Your input means the world to us!
We’ll share more details once we will announce the demo, so keep an eye out for updates. In the meantime, if you haven’t already, please follow & wishlist our game! It really helps us out as we gear up for launch!

Wrapping Up
We can’t thank you enough for your enthusiasm and support as we head into the final stretch of development for Exotica Pet Shop Simulator 2. These monthly updates are our chance to show you what we’ve been working on and get you hyped for what’s coming. We’re so close to sharing this game with you, and we can’t wait to see the amazing pet shops you’ll create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2824380/Exotica_Pet_Shop_Simulator_2/

Until next time! Keep dreaming of those rare hatchlings and stay tuned for more news!

-----------------
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/413d6caf6e2705a772b1c7d3364d7f04a38e16f5.png

notes.title: ANIMAL SPECIES
notes.content:
HELLO ANIMAL LOVERS 👋

We are here with a new Devlog.

While we are announcing that we have changed the name of the game to Exotica Pet Shop Simulator 2, we would also like to show the new animals.

We want to have more animal varieties in the game. We wanted to show you some of the animals we added to the game as a result of the feedback we received from you. These animals will also have different colors and patterns.


 You will be able to care for and raise them from puppyhood.
 They will be able to roam completely freely within the shop premises.
 You will be able to name them and make them your own pet. (Warning: The animal you name belongs entirely to you and cannot be sold.)
 You will need to put a bed for your named pet.
 Unnamed animals will be fed from the food bowl nearby.
 In order to sell your unnamed dogs, they must be in a stand or in the shelter section (Large type dogs).

 You will be able to care for and raise them from a young age.

notes.title: CUSTOMER SUGGESTION SYSTEM
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers 👋

Upon your request, you will be able to suggest other animals, livingspaces, feeds and accessories to the customer by editing the customer's wish list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/14dedf0121dad72004b9b389a01bd62f116ba350.png

E1:
Indicates the customer type. There are 3 types of customers in the game. (Good, moderate and stubborn customer)

 Good customer: Has a high tendency to accept your suggestion.
 Moderate customer: Can accept your suggestion with a 50% rate.
 Stubborn customer: Will accept your suggestion with a 2% rate.


E2: 
When you click the edit button of the item you will suggest, the items that are most suitable for the customer's wish list will be listed.

E3: 
This is the part that shows how many items you have in stock of the item listed in the window that opens.

E4: 
This rate is the percentage of the customer accepting the request. However, you should not forget that; No matter how high a rate you choose, each customer may not accept this request and this rate varies for each customer type.

notes.title: Interacting with Animals
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers 👋

Since the announcement of Pet Shop Simulator 2, we are happy to share with you some of the features we are developing for the first time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/61be16b62606e1b50a06574fe6040e0d94106042.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/6efc3bde9d8496514e0595fab97b457c52169de5.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/f48977dc318f4493704d22b62b94b8f893f77b85.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869038/2e2cd51b3c8f429e842392658e7992583e9bc001.gif

We thought it would be good to interact more with your pets. So take care of your animals. We didn't want your animals to be stuck in their living spaces, so we think free-roam animals will be happier. Of course, they shouldn't go too far. :)

All animals, except fish and arthropods, will be able to roam freely in the shop and you will be able to teach your parrots new words.

🐶NOTE:😻
You must place food bowls inside the shop for free-roaming animals.

You can join our Discord channel for your requests and suggestions. With your participation, we can make more player-oriented developments. You can also add this game to your wishlist on Steam so you don't miss future dev logs!👍👇
